item.title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
item.description: StateBench tests how language models track changing information across long documents at four difficulty levels, revealing where models struggle and how targeted training helps recurrent and hybrid architectures handle longer sequences.

item.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
item.description: ToyBlocks is an open simulation framework for studying robot learning through automated task generation, training demonstrations, and evaluation in a controlled tabletop world.
